title: Iran Offers a "Two-Day Plan" to Reopen the Strait of Hormuz
en: Iranian negotiators were in Doha on Sunday for a third consecutive day of talks with Qatari mediators aimed at ending the eight-month war with the United States and Israel. Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi said Tehran had agreed to a "two-day plan": on the first day Washington would carry out a series of measures, and on the second the Strait of Hormuz would reopen and shipping would return to normal. He said Iran was prepared for "both defence and diplomacy". Secretary of State Marco Rubio said President Donald Trump had not yet decided whether to launch new strikes, but would prefer a diplomatic path. The US midterm elections on November 3 could shift the calculations on both sides.
zh: 伊朗谈判代表周日连续第三天在卡塔尔首都多哈与卡塔尔调解方会谈，寻求结束已持续八个月的对美以战争。伊朗外长阿拉格齐表示，德黑兰已同意一项“两天计划”：第一天美方将采取一系列措施，第二天霍尔木兹海峡将重新开放、航运恢复正常。他说伊朗已做好“防御与外交”两手准备。美国国务卿鲁比奥表示，特朗普总统尚未决定是否发动新的打击，但更倾向于外交途径。11月3日的美国中期选举可能改变双方的盘算。

title: OPEC+ Producers Hold December Output Steady
en: Seven major OPEC+ producers reaffirmed on Sunday that they will keep December crude output unchanged, extending the quota level agreed for September. Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Kazakhstan, Algeria and Oman met online to review the oil market. The group had raised production month by month from April to September before pausing in October. A statement gave no reason for the decision, but sources say members are still struggling with export disruptions caused by the Middle East conflict and are unlikely to adjust policy again before next year. Producers must finish capacity assessments in the fourth quarter before setting 2027 baselines. Brent crude has traded above $110 a barrel for much of late October.
zh: 七个“欧佩克+”主要产油国周日重申，12月将维持原油产量不变，延续9月确定的配额水平。沙特阿拉伯、俄罗斯、伊拉克、科威特、哈萨克斯坦、阿尔及利亚和阿曼的代表举行线上会议，研判石油市场形势。该集团曾在4月至9月逐月增产，10月起暂停。声明未说明理由，但消息人士称，成员国仍在应对中东冲突造成的出口中断，明年之前不太可能再次调整政策。各产油国须在第四季度完成产能评估，才能确定2027年配额基准。10月下旬布伦特原油多数时间在每桶110美元上方运行。

title: Two Fed Officials Argue for Further Rate Hikes
en: Two Federal Reserve officials used Friday to argue for further tightening. Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan, a 2026 voter, said the central bank needs at least two more quarter-point hikes, though a pause after 50 basis points of tightening would make sense to gauge the need for more. She said gradual adjustments lower the risk of a sharp deterioration and give households and businesses time to adapt, adding that it was unacceptable for inflation to stay above the 2% target. St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem, a 2028 voter, said rates would need to rise again "soon", warning that earlier action reduces the risk of broader economic damage. Futures markets now price a December hike at roughly 70%.
zh: 两位美联储官员上周五主张进一步收紧政策。达拉斯联储主席洛根（2026年票委）表示，美联储至少还需加息两次、每次25个基点，不过在累计加息50个基点后暂停一次以评估是否需要更多行动是合理的。她说，渐进调整可降低经济急剧恶化的风险，也让家庭和企业有时间适应，并强调通胀不回到2%目标不可接受。圣路易斯联储主席穆萨莱姆（2028年票委）称利率需要“很快”再次上调，并警告越早行动越能缩小经济受损范围。期货市场目前对12月加息的定价约为70%。

title: OpenAI Trims Fundraising Target to About $20 Billion
en: OpenAI has cut the target for its current fundraising round by $10 billion to about $20 billion, according to the Financial Times, as a selloff in AI stocks and rival Anthropic's looming listing complicate efforts to lock in investor commitments. The reduced target comes with a lower valuation of $1.25 trillion, down from $1.4 trillion a month ago, when the company was seeking $30 billion. The two firms are chasing overlapping institutional investors, and Anthropic's initial public offering could divert capital that might otherwise have gone to OpenAI. The shift underscores how quickly sentiment in the artificial intelligence sector has turned after a year of record private valuations.
zh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，OpenAI已将本轮融资目标下调100亿美元至约200亿美元，原因是AI股票遭抛售、竞争对手Anthropic即将上市，令其争取投资者承诺变得更加困难。随目标下调，公司估值从一个月前的1.4万亿美元降至1.25万亿美元，当时其融资目标为300亿美元。两家公司争夺的机构投资者存在重叠，Anthropic的首次公开募股可能分流原本投向OpenAI的资金。这一变化凸显，在经历了一年创纪录的私募估值后，人工智能板块情绪转变得多么迅速。
vocab: adj. 迫近的，即将发生的

title: Anthropic Files for Nasdaq Listing at Up to $2 Trillion Valuation
en: Anthropic has filed publicly with the US Securities and Exchange Commission for a Nasdaq listing under the ticker ANT, with people familiar with the matter saying the debut could come in mid-November. Investors have discussed a valuation of roughly $1.5 trillion, below the $2 trillion once floated, while the company hopes to raise as much as $100 billion in what would be the largest IPO on record. Revenue reached $16.29 billion in the first half of 2026, up from $4.6 billion for all of 2025, and the company posted $974 million of operating profit in the second quarter. It has committed to more than $800 billion in computing contracts across Nvidia, AMD, Google TPU and Amazon Trainium chips.
zh: Anthropic已向美国证券交易委员会公开递交招股书，拟以代码ANT在纳斯达克上市，知情人士称最快可能于11月中旬挂牌。投资者讨论的估值约为1.5万亿美元，低于此前传出的2万亿美元；公司拟募资最高1000亿美元，将成为史上最大规模IPO。2026年上半年营收达162.9亿美元，而2025年全年为46亿美元；二季度实现营业利润9.74亿美元。公司已在英伟达、AMD、谷歌TPU和亚马逊Trainium等芯片上签下总额超过8000亿美元的算力合同。

title: Cost-of-Living Protests Sweep European Cities
en: Protests over the cost of living swept across Europe on Saturday, with hundreds of thousands of people taking to the streets in France, Germany, Italy, Portugal, Spain and the Netherlands. France deployed about 70,000 police and gendarmes and closed more than 40 metro stations in Paris; the interior ministry said around 320,000 people joined demonstrations nationwide and 422 were arrested. In Germany organisers said about 120,000 people turned out in 34 cities, with water cannon used in some areas. Italian unions put turnout at 1.5 million, while the interior ministry counted about 255,000. Demonstrators demanded action on housing, education, health spending and military budgets.
zh: 周六，围绕生活成本问题的抗议席卷欧洲，法国、德国、意大利、葡萄牙、西班牙和荷兰数十万人走上街头。法国部署约7万名警察和宪兵，并关闭巴黎40多个地铁站；内政部称全国约32万人参加示威，422人被捕。德国组织方称34座城市约12万人参与，部分地区动用高压水炮。意大利工会称参与人数达150万，内政部统计约25.5万。示威者要求政府在住房、教育、医疗投入和军费等问题上采取行动。
vocab: v. 席卷（sweep 的过去式）
